text.en:
Functions - The PMEPC shall continue to exercise its
functions and responsibilities as provided under EO 159 dated December 23,
2002, in relation to EO 194 and EO 195, both dated April 14, 2003.

Compositions - The membership of the Committee, as
enumerated under Section 3 of EO 159, as amended by EO 722, is hereby

Funding - The Committee shall utilize its unused CY 2010
balance for its administrative and operational expenses, subject to the usual
government accounting and auditing rules and regulations.

Repeal - All other rules, regulations and issuances or parts
thereof which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or
modified accordingly.

Effectivity and Retroactivity - This Order shall take effect
immediately and retroact to 1 July 2010.
Done in the City of Manila, this 2nd day or Septemberin the year of Our
Lord, Two Thousand and Ten.
By the President
PAQUITO N. OCHOA JR.
Executive Secretary

MARIANITO M. DIMAANDAL
